l.i: doctiores, & magis idoneos servos suos, qui quod à me præstari nequit, in hoc
genere scribendi præstetur. Spes enim est fore ut permulti, qui nunc
sola prolixitate commentariorum deterriti, vel nihil vel pauca, & exiguo cum fructu legunt,
Scripturas legerent avidius, si breviculi aliquid ad scopum

page.notes: The woodcut ornament (heart-shaped floral design) is not text. The signature line reads "Da. Dicsonus." as printed; "Valę" is as printed. The passage has a dotted underline under some words, not transcribed.
